description: Footpaths in the City of Port Adelaide Enfield is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Port Adelaide Enfield Council. Footpaths in the City of Port Adelaide Enfield. Polygon spatial layer. Attributed with asset id and structural material. The spatial extent of each footpath is a schematic representation only and in many cases includes the area of the verge too. However the Length and Width field values are accurate. Coverage: Port Adelaide Enfield Council. The portal files it under the publisher Port Adelaide Enfield Council. Its tags are council, footpaths, infrastructure, port adelaide enfield. It offers 1 resource(s) in MIXED FORMATS. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
